label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is request.getHeader("Referer") (via param -> bar -> obj -> printf). The doSomething method preserves user input in bar despite adding/removing constants ("safe", "moresafe"). Direct injection into HTML response without encoding constitutes a real vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input acquired from request.getHeader("Referer") assigned to param.
doSomething method: param added to list, "safe" removed, bar assigned list.get(0) which resolves to param.
Sink: obj array populated with bar and printed via response.getWriter().printf without HTML encoding.
